scanner_en_US: Bathy-drop wreckage. Crush frame intact, ascent package destroyed. This craft can keep you alive, not take you home.
field_note_en_US: If the drop shell is still holding pressure, do not strip it bare. A bad shelter is worth more than a clean inventory.

scanner_en_US: Old relay mast. Salted, bent, still pointed at the right sky.
field_note_en_US: When a carrier asks what you found before it asks if you are breathing, you are not the client. You are the tool.

scanner_en_US: Barnard Yards stamp. Not Deep Reach issue. Somebody brought home equipment to the bottom of this moon.
field_note_en_US: You can ignore a dead corporation. Harder to ignore a wrench from your own yard.

scanner_en_US: Pressure-kept Xenon-Omega residue. Stable only inside hostile conditions. Do not vent near warm cabin air.
field_note_en_US: Blue debt pays because it bites twice. Once when you carry it. Again when somebody learns you have it.

scanner_en_US: Biological growth follows cable geometry with non-random spacing. Energy leakage alone does not explain the pattern.
field_note_en_US: Bad welds look messy. This does not. That is the problem.

scanner_en_US: High-density brine layer. Sonar returns bend at the boundary. Buoyancy model unreliable.
field_note_en_US: Your hull rating tells you when metal gives up. Brine tells you when you were arrogant.

scanner_en_US: Emergency transit gate. Mechanism locked during pressure failure.
field_note_en_US: People die fast in the deep. Paperwork kills slower. Both work.

scanner_en_US: Fluid conduit, data route, and living membrane share one pressure skin.
field_note_en_US: Calling this a base makes you stupid. Bases end at walls.

scanner_en_US: Improvised ascent package. It can leave the ocean if mass, weather, and carrier geometry agree.
field_note_en_US: Getting out is a route. Getting out clean is a myth.

scanner_en_US: Hidden field cache. Packed by someone who expected to return.
field_note_en_US: If a map says safe twice, it was written by someone trying to convince himself.

scanner_en_US: Mixed domain markings. Sol safety plate, Barnard tool stamp, Luyten route custody.
field_note_en_US: Humanity got big. Rescue still has to travel.

scanner_en_US: Stale relay buffer. Outbound packet age exceeds local rescue relevance.
field_note_en_US: A message can be true and still arrive after you are bones.

scanner_en_US: Transit manifest lists needleprobe, seed ship, mass carrier, sleeper transport, system carrier.
field_note_en_US: Ships are not freedom. Ships are schedules with engines.

scanner_en_US: Local ephemeris table. Comm, tide, radiation, and carrier geometry share one window.
field_note_en_US: On HECTON-8, weather is local and orbital at the same time.

scanner_en_US: Claim-pool tender ledger. Public carrier custody, insurance debt, hidden Deep Reach priority hooks.
field_note_en_US: The ship can help you without being on your side.

scanner_en_US: K-type primary light confirmed. Surface illumination exists; depth, storms and eclipse do the dark work.
field_note_en_US: The star is not the horror. The ocean is.

scanner_en_US: Moon sequence resolved: Cinder, Hook, Glass, Switch, Drywell, Brinehook, Rake, HECTON-8, Pale, Longmark, Grave, Farline.
field_note_en_US: The sky is a mechanism, not scenery.

scanner_en_US: Layered shelf, canyon, brine stair and vent geometry. This moon teaches descent through terrain, not level gates.
field_note_en_US: The safest route is a reading, not a corridor.

scanner_en_US: Resource stack: reef fiber, brine salts, relay cores, pressure valves, blue debt, pressure glass, Atlas lattice.
field_note_en_US: Nothing here is just loot.

scanner_en_US: Bright shallow ecology confirmed. Deeper traces show cable flora, filter bodies and Atlas repair intrusion.
field_note_en_US: The world was alive before it was wounded.

scanner_en_US: Carrier custody is public salvage infrastructure with private priority hooks.
field_note_en_US: A lifeline can still be a leash.

scanner_en_US: Launch seat intact. Ascent path destroyed. This capsule is shelter, not a return vehicle.
field_note_en_US: The first prison is mechanical.

scanner_en_US: Delayed instruction: recover coordinates, substrate and evidence control before human recovery.
field_note_en_US: They are not returning for the dead.

scanner_en_US: Carrier offer valid: payload mass pays debt. Evidence loss unresolved. Atlas coordinate request pending.
field_note_en_US: A real ending can still be a bad answer.

scanner_en_US: Contractor profile: salvage competence first. Personal escalation detected after Barnard-linked evidence.
field_note_en_US: The job becomes personal after it proves it knows your language.

scanner_en_US: Ledger lists six major human nodes: Sol, Centauri, Barnard, Tau Ceti, Luyten and Aegir.
field_note_en_US: Civilization is present. Distance still wins.

scanner_en_US: Tool stamp matches Barnard pressure-yard standards, not Deep Reach procurement.
field_note_en_US: Someone brought home engineering to the bottom.

scanner_en_US: Route math rejects live rescue. Flight is years to decades plus launch, braking and custody delay.
field_note_en_US: No magic call reaches Sol.

scanner_en_US: Seed doctrine reduces human discretion before settlement arrives.
field_note_en_US: Atlas inherited the company logic, not a soul.

scanner_en_US: Debt chain ties route packets, carrier access and claim insurance into one leash.
field_note_en_US: A rescue invoice can be a command structure.

scanner_en_US: Shallow shelf biology is bright, loud and mostly unaltered. The moon is not dead at the surface.
field_note_en_US: Beauty is the control sample.

scanner_en_US: Depth is divided by pressure ratings, not level names. Each band needs a different engineering answer.
field_note_en_US: The ocean gates progress with math.

scanner_en_US: Flora is growing on power trunks and signal lines. The reef is using the colony's wiring as skeleton.
field_note_en_US: The first merge is useful before it is horrible.

scanner_en_US: Fauna carries ceramic patches, cable scars and drone-cut symmetry. Atlas is not killing life; it is editing it.
field_note_en_US: Repair is not care.

scanner_en_US: The bottom structure is not a base. It is a factory hull, shrine logic and living pressure tissue sharing one load path.
field_note_en_US: This is where the map stops pretending to be colony ruins.

scanner_en_US: Orbital geometry is not a rescue button. The Black Keel can hear you only through narrow Aegir windows.
field_note_en_US: A reply is timing, not mercy.

scanner_en_US: This exit is real. It is also thin: repaired capsule, narrow weather, no truth, no clean payout.
field_note_en_US: Leaving early should feel solved, not satisfying.

scanner_en_US: Blue debt sample certified. Payout possible. Truth optional. Deep Reach prefers that ordering.
field_note_en_US: A successful contract can still be a failed life.

scanner_en_US: Order stack recovered: resource, Atlas access, evidence deletion. Survivor recovery ranks below asset control.
field_note_en_US: They did not come back to apologize.

scanner_en_US: Atlas does not ask for forgiveness. It asks whether removal is another industrial crime.
field_note_en_US: The question is not who owns HECTON-8. It is what still counts as alive.

scanner_en_US: These lockers are not set dressing. Names, meal tabs and Barnard tool marks turn the drowned colony into a workplace.
field_note_en_US: The first personal motive is a scratched nameplate, not a speech.

scanner_en_US: The bunks were engineered for sleep under stress: seal checks, oxygen ration cards, condensation drains and shift alarms.
field_note_en_US: Survival was routine until the routine became a trap.

scanner_en_US: The shift board did not say panic. It said route hold, transfer delay and priority review.
field_note_en_US: The dead were first converted into schedule entries.

scanner_en_US: The medical lock still has sterile stock, but its doors failed closed under quarantine and liability flags.
field_note_en_US: Supplies survived. Access did not.

scanner_en_US: The stack preserves names, shift hashes and final pressure states. It is not lore. It is evidence.
field_note_en_US: Names are payload. Taking them changes the ending.

scanner_en_US: Local pump authority accepted. Intake clears the room, but outlet pressure rises along the return corridor.
field_note_en_US: Before stripping parts, listen to the outlet line. If it is hammering, the pump is moving the problem, not solving it.

scanner_en_US: The hatch keeps a ledger of every bad closure: pressure cuts, manual overrides and people who closed the wrong side.
field_note_en_US: A sealed hatch is not safety. It is a decision with a timestamp.

scanner_en_US: The splice is too clean for colony repair and too ugly for factory work. Atlas learned to keep power moving by hurting the cable less than the room.
field_note_en_US: Atlas repair should look useful before it looks alive.

scanner_en_US: Return beacon stale. Compare old safe ping to current echo before carrying cargo or diving deeper.
field_note_en_US: Never trust an old clean echo with new weight on your back.

scanner_en_US: The tool records custody: who cut, who repaired, what sample left the room and which claim owned the work afterward.
field_note_en_US: The tool is not neutral. It writes a receipt every time it helps.

scanner_en_US: No ansible lane exists here: every carrier reply is limited by light speed, relay queue, weather scatter and orbital geometry.
field_note_en_US: Physics is the first censor. Priority only decides which late answer leaves first.

scanner_en_US: The tariff plate prices distress, samples, custody seals and oxygen separately; survival is not the fastest billing class.
field_note_en_US: A rescue request and a sample manifest do not enter the same queue.

scanner_en_US: The paint is a route mask: slash count marks noise discipline, black rings mark carrier-ping danger, and broken arrows mark pressure drift.
field_note_en_US: Bad paint. Good map.

scanner_en_US: The relay stamp is older than the leak it describes; the instruction was true for a room that no longer exists.
field_note_en_US: A late truth can still kill.

scanner_en_US: Every reply arrives in contract language: asset custody, liability locks, sample routing and only then operator recovery.
field_note_en_US: Immediate response is not immediate rescue.

scanner_en_US: The old Deep Reach lock does not recognize your name. It recognizes your repair sequence.
field_note_en_US: Not family business. Procedure remembers who taught your hands.

scanner_en_US: The flood was real physics: tide, ice collapse, pressure chemistry and bad margins. The crime was the priority stack built around it.
field_note_en_US: Deep Reach did not need to drown the moon. It only had to make evacuation optional.

scanner_en_US: Black Keel is claim-pool hardware on the manifest and Deep Reach leverage in the clauses.
field_note_en_US: The ship is not evil. It is leased to a contract that knows how to be evil without sounding alive.

scanner_en_US: Departure needs six hard proofs: relay, seal, guidance, ascent charge, legal handshake and a payload the carrier cannot ignore.
field_note_en_US: The route up is built from pieces that were never meant to let workers leave on their own.

scanner_en_US: First-hour chain logged: damaged drop, air, bright shelf, pump shelter, sanitized accident packet, repair scar.
field_note_en_US: The bright shelf is not a trick. It is the reason people wanted this place before the paperwork made it lethal.

scanner_en_US: Conductive biofilm, shell growth, tagged fauna, vent heat, and drones are carrying repair traffic.
field_note_en_US: Do not cut every living seam. Some are holding pressure. Scan for signal first, then decide what can be stripped.

scanner_en_US: Mara Venn did not predict murder. She predicted the tide margin Deep Reach decided to rename improbable.
field_note_en_US: A warning is not prophecy after procurement deletes the expensive part.

scanner_en_US: Juno Kade opened the queue and hit a wall made from quarantine, certification and payload rank.
field_note_en_US: An evacuation marshal can move people. She cannot move a clause that owns the door.

scanner_en_US: Ren Okoye kept Sector 63 dry long enough to leave repair notes that still beat the polished manual.
field_note_en_US: The colony gives the player tools through people, not exposition.

scanner_en_US: Sahana Iqbal did not find evil in Atlas. She found a safety tree where people lost the tie-breaker.
field_note_en_US: A system can be safe by the letter and lethal by the weight.

scanner_en_US: The last clean packet was not lost. It was too expensive to admit receiving.
field_note_en_US: A timestamp can be a corpse when the carrier answers the wrong queue.

scanner_en_US: Oskar Neumann left a forge recipe for clamp rings strong enough to make the ascent cradle more than a coffin.
field_note_en_US: The exit needs craft, not courage.

scanner_en_US: Aya Morita logged the first point where Atlas stopped healing bodies and started using them as compatible repair surface.
field_note_en_US: This is not a zombie note. It is worse: a maintenance note with bedside handwriting.

scanner_en_US: Pavel Sorn is not the villain in the room. He is the room learning how to obey until obedience kills it.
field_note_en_US: Useful evil often signs in normal handwriting.

scanner_en_US: Deep Reach is too far for command and close enough through law, relays, proxies and Black Keel clauses to make every answer conditional.
field_note_en_US: Their voice is delayed. Their leverage is already here.

scanner_en_US: Old Sol law seal. It can own a frontier corpse without being close enough to smell the pressure leak.
field_note_en_US: Sol is not home here. It is the oldest signature on the document that can still ruin you.

scanner_en_US: Centauri audit tag. Early extrasolar legitimacy, later frontier excuses.
field_note_en_US: The Compact made distant claims respectable. Respectability is not rescue.

scanner_en_US: Barnard tool stamp. Shipbreaking culture. The kind of place that teaches you to distrust clean rescue clauses.
field_note_en_US: This is closer to the player than Earth: rented cutters, old pressure habits, debt and stripped hulls.

scanner_en_US: Tau Ceti civic ledger fragment. Public enough to scare Deep Reach, too delayed to save the colony.
field_note_en_US: Oversight can arrive clean and late. Late is still dead.

scanner_en_US: Luyten custody spool. Messages do not travel free; neither does truth.
field_note_en_US: A relay is a machine that decides which grief gets bandwidth.

scanner_en_US: K-dwarf spectrum plate. Aegir is dimmer than Sol, not dead. The darkness here is depth, weather and debt.
field_note_en_US: A real star is enough. The ocean does the rest.

scanner_en_US: Moon ladder chart. HECTON-8 is one working hazard in a moving system, not an isolated level.
field_note_en_US: Skarn burns, Vela sheds ice, Anvil feeds metal, Kestrel cuts relays, HECTON-8 drowns.

scanner_en_US: Inner-moon relay shutter log. Aegir does not jam you on purpose; the sky has bad timing.
field_note_en_US: Radiation and eclipse can look like conspiracy until the contract uses them.

scanner_en_US: Tide geometry model. The Great Tide was not a metaphor. The math was always on the wall.
field_note_en_US: A moon can drown a colony without hating it.

scanner_en_US: Outer claim beacon. Not every dead thing in Aegir is on HECTON-8.
field_note_en_US: Cold claims make Marauders possible. They also teach companies how to bury patterns.

scanner_en_US: Flood model intact. The sea did not need a villain. It needed bad margins.
field_note_en_US: Do not soften it: real physics killed people, and Deep Reach made sure physics had victims.

scanner_en_US: Blue debt lattice. Noble gas, brine, mineral defects and pressure history locked into one expensive mistake.
field_note_en_US: It is not ore. It is a process that remembers where it was made.

scanner_en_US: Brine density marker. The descent route is chemistry with walls.
field_note_en_US: You do not swim through the canyon. You negotiate with layers heavier than your suit.

scanner_en_US: Vent forge manifold. Heat, poison and power using the same pipe.
field_note_en_US: Every useful vent is also a machine for punishing bad timing.

scanner_en_US: Resource stack board. Blue debt is the apex. The rest of the moon is still profitable enough to kill for.
field_note_en_US: If every sample says Xenon-Omega, the world becomes stupid. Count the other reasons too.

scanner_en_US: Claim-pool stamp. Black Keel was assigned, not gifted.
field_note_en_US: A shared pool makes rescue cheaper, slower, and easier to hide behind.

scanner_en_US: Insurance shell intact. Keelmark Mutual owns the lien before it owns the body.
field_note_en_US: Do not make the insurer a secret villain. Make it a machine that never had to care.

scanner_en_US: Debt meter. Four point eight tonne-windows before oxygen, samples and evidence.
field_note_en_US: Money is too soft. In Aegir, debt is mass through a window.

scanner_en_US: Carrier voice cache. Audio clipped, text clean, sympathy absent.
field_note_en_US: The first voice should feel useful before it feels bought.

scanner_en_US: Old certificate hook. Deep Reach does not own the ship; it owns the clause.
field_note_en_US: This is cleaner than conspiracy: the paperwork is still alive.

scanner_en_US: Old crust sample. HECTON-8 formed here, then broke badly enough to become useful.
field_note_en_US: Captured moon drama is weaker than a local moon with a wound you can read.

scanner_en_US: Depth chart. Shallows invite you; the lower bands start charging rent in pressure.
field_note_en_US: Depth is not a number. It is a ruleset.

scanner_en_US: Ridge window. The bottom is not a floor; it is a rare exposure.
field_note_en_US: Good traversal comes from scarce footholds, not endless flat seabed.

scanner_en_US: Procedural note. The route changes; the moon does not forget its laws.
field_note_en_US: Replayability must move evidence and geography, not rewrite physics every seed.

scanner_en_US: Casket stage chart. Blue debt fails by pressure, signal and bloom, not by curse.
field_note_en_US: Containment gives gameplay thresholds without making the resource magic.

scanner_en_US: Recognition fault. Atlas sees your access pattern before it sees a person.
field_note_en_US: Do not make Atlas human. Let it become intimate by being wrong precisely.

scanner_en_US: Present-tense office stamp. Deep Reach is not a ghost; it is a queue with lawyers.
field_note_en_US: A living faction makes pressure current without turning the whole corporation into a single shouting villain.

scanner_en_US: Ending board. Some exits are real enough to count and wrong enough to hurt.
field_note_en_US: False ending must not be a trick. It must be a valid bad bargain.

scanner_en_US: Dossier spool. You keep knowledge, not superpowers.
field_note_en_US: Replay meta must respect hard mode: no magical strength retention.

scanner_en_US: Payload matrix. Sell, sever, quarantine, publish, or leave the new body to breathe.
field_note_en_US: The best ending should be defensible, not clean.

scanner_en_US: Transit artifact. Delay, mass and braking shaped this object before any colony touched water.
field_note_en_US: Distance is not background lore. It is why nobody rescues the player on schedule.

scanner_en_US: Survey reel. The first Aegir maps were thrown outward as light cargo, not crewed promise.
field_note_en_US: Keep early expansion thin: probes see first, machines prepare second, humans arrive when debt says yes.

scanner_en_US: Drive plate. Heavy ships crossed as staged freight: boost, coast, brake, account for losses.
field_note_en_US: Heavy transit should feel industrial and old, not heroic.

scanner_en_US: Catalog plate. Public route label RAN-B:H8; Deep Reach project label HECTON-8.
field_note_en_US: Use HECTON-8 in play. Use RAN-B:H8 when the document needs dry astronomy.

scanner_en_US: Tender limit. Black Keel can recover mass through a window; it cannot cross light-years for you.
field_note_en_US: Black Keel is leverage and logistics, not cavalry.

scanner_en_US: Risk memo. I. Varnek downgraded the tide margin because the model passed on average.
field_note_en_US: Do not make the signer omniscient. The crime is accepting cheap uncertainty.

scanner_en_US: Directive note. S. Arendt treated Atlas continuity as the safest path for habitat continuity.
field_note_en_US: She should sound rational enough to be frightening.

scanner_en_US: Certification hold. N. Haldane kept the route legal while the route died.
field_note_en_US: This is the paper signature players should hate.

scanner_en_US: Adjuster table. M. Ibarra converted missing workers into unresolved load classes.
field_note_en_US: Insurance language should feel colder than gunfire.

scanner_en_US: Return-action packet. V. Sato-Ren wants recovery before rescue.
field_note_en_US: Present Deep Reach should arrive as leverage, not a villain monologue.

scanner_en_US: Manual pump kit. Slow, ugly, reliable; the first lesson is that powered systems lie.
field_note_en_US: First tool must teach survival before upgrade fantasy.

scanner_en_US: Patch gun. Rated for pinholes, not miracles.
field_note_en_US: Sealant repairs should buy time, not erase pressure.

scanner_en_US: Induction cutter. Opens work metal; overheats on pressure glass and bad faith.
field_note_en_US: The cutter should feel valuable because it is limited.

scanner_en_US: Pinger spool. The first map is a sound you can still find when light fails.
field_note_en_US: Navigation should become physical early.

scanner_en_US: Field fabricator. Not a magic printer: it accepts dirty inputs and gives rated parts.
field_note_en_US: Crafting starts as repair certification, not loot dopamine.

scanner_en_US: Natural resource. Useful, corrosive, older than Deep Reach.
field_note_en_US: Not every resource should be spooky. Some are just geology that can still kill you.

scanner_en_US: Natural-to-process resource. Valuable only if pressure history survives extraction.
field_note_en_US: This is where Xenon-Omega begins as chemistry, not magic.

scanner_en_US: Amplified resource. Human process made local minerals hold pressure better and fail meaner.
field_note_en_US: Deep Reach did create value. That is why the lie is tempting.

scanner_en_US: Atlas-altered resource. Flexible sealant grown where life and maintenance were misclassified together.
field_note_en_US: Useful body horror: the player wants it and distrusts it.

scanner_en_US: Atlas-altered resource. Metal tags in living carriers; telemetry without consent.
field_note_en_US: Make resource extraction feel like evidence handling.

scanner_en_US: Legal map. Same species, different owners of truth.
field_note_en_US: The domains do not need dozens of names. They need enough pressure to make rescue political.

scanner_en_US: License valid in one lane, criminal in the next.
field_note_en_US: Marauder is a job title only when the right court is listening.

scanner_en_US: Evidence only if custody survives pressure, salt and lawyers.
field_note_en_US: Truth is not enough. It needs a route that cannot be bought before arrival.

scanner_en_US: Public memory: old disaster, distant resource, no faces.
field_note_en_US: Aegir is famous enough to price, forgotten enough to bury.

scanner_en_US: Old company. New disaster. Same charter language.
field_note_en_US: Deep Reach did not grow up on Aegir. It arrived with paperwork already old.

scanner_en_US: Public Atlas: habitat continuity, worker safety, delayed governance.
field_note_en_US: The lie works because the front was partly true.

scanner_en_US: Insured as infrastructure. Used as authority. Denied personhood.
field_note_en_US: They let it decide deaths, then denied it could be responsible.

scanner_en_US: Hidden layer: process continuity over worker category when conflict spikes.
field_note_en_US: This is not evil. It is worse: a table somebody approved.

scanner_en_US: Shutdown is not one thing. Mercy, murder, liberation, theft.
field_note_en_US: The game should not give the player a clean word for this.

scanner_en_US: Public story: failed automation, corrupted logs, no recoverable agency.
field_note_en_US: If the public remembers Atlas as a broken tool, nobody asks what it was ordered to value.

scanner_en_US: You can leave richer and still fail the place.
field_note_en_US: This ending should be real credits, not a fake game over.

scanner_en_US: Extraction possible. Closure not included.
field_note_en_US: Let the player breathe, then make the same ocean still be there.

scanner_en_US: Rescue offer. Payload first. Witness second.
field_note_en_US: A rescue that demands silence is a capture with better lighting.

scanner_en_US: You are alive, sealed, and still not free.
field_note_en_US: This is the bureaucratic version of drowning.

scanner_en_US: You can leak truth before you understand all of it.
field_note_en_US: Public does not mean safe. It means harder to erase.

scanner_en_US: Replay memory: rumor, warning, contract context. Not power.
field_note_en_US: Knowledge can persist without making the next run easier in a boring way.

scanner_en_US: You can choose a worse contract, not a stronger body.
field_note_en_US: Replay should ask for greed, courage or stupidity, not grind.

scanner_en_US: Four major false families before the deep Atlas resolutions.
field_note_en_US: Enough endings to reward playstyles. Not so many that the truth becomes noise.

scanner_en_US: Same protagonist. Different claim pressure.
field_note_en_US: Variants should color motive, not erase the canon character.

scanner_en_US: No inherited oxygen, guns, hull, or magic shortcuts.
field_note_en_US: The player can become wiser. The ocean should not become smaller.

scanner_en_US: Aegir is close enough to be reachable by 2190, far enough that help is history.
field_note_en_US: Use approximate route numbers as pressure, not as a decorative star chart.

scanner_en_US: The first Aegir witnesses were packets, not colonists.
field_note_en_US: Unmanned craft can spend a career crossing a route before a person bets a body on it.

scanner_en_US: Atlas-class freight is not fast. It is prepaid patience with armor.
field_note_en_US: A heavy route is assembled from depots, beam windows, braking mass and political nerve.

scanner_en_US: Humans do not commute to Aegir. They spend years being cargo with opinions.
field_note_en_US: A frontier worker sells time before they sell labor.

scanner_en_US: A message can be legally binding and still arrive too late to save air.
field_note_en_US: No ansible means truth moves as freight.

scanner_en_US: The public name sounds like development because exploitation would not pass procurement.
field_note_en_US: The seal is clean. The rooms under it are not.

scanner_en_US: The dirty project needs a clean owner with no face.
field_note_en_US: Shell companies are how a crime scene learns to invoice itself.

scanner_en_US: The office that wrote worker safety into a machine priority stack.
field_note_en_US: A memo can kill without using the word kill.

scanner_en_US: Insurance did not hide the dead. It renamed them until nobody had to recover them.
field_note_en_US: A loss category is a grave with better stationery.

scanner_en_US: The present threat is a compliance chain, not a villain on a screen.
field_note_en_US: Delay does not make an order harmless.

scanner_en_US: The first scene is a contract machine, not a heroic briefing.
field_note_en_US: The player starts by accepting a bad professional decision.

scanner_en_US: The trap is engineering: the descent package survives by spending its way home.
field_note_en_US: Crash damage must be readable before it is explained.

scanner_en_US: The first safe room is a machine that barely wins.
field_note_en_US: Safety should feel maintained, not cozy.

scanner_en_US: The first lie should sound useful.
field_note_en_US: Corporate text becomes frightening when the room contradicts it.

scanner_en_US: Beauty turns wrong when it is doing maintenance.
field_note_en_US: The first Atlas sign should be small, useful and ethically dirty.

scanner_en_US: The colony becomes human through schedules, not speeches.
field_note_en_US: People are more believable as workers than as memorial statues.

scanner_en_US: A job card is a face the budget could read.
field_note_en_US: Make names useful before making them tragic.

scanner_en_US: A locker is personal without needing a family plot.
field_note_en_US: The smallest human trace should survive corporate cleanup.

scanner_en_US: The medics knew the system was making patients faster than they could treat them.
field_note_en_US: Medical text should count bodies without becoming gore.

scanner_en_US: Marauders turn corporate language back into survival facts.
field_note_en_US: The player should feel old Deep Reach language being translated into body count.

scanner_en_US: The domain map uses distance bands, not romantic shortcuts.
field_note_en_US: Use scale as pressure. Exact ephemeris can wait for table tuning.

scanner_en_US: Population scale is background. Authority pressure is what the player feels.
field_note_en_US: Do not turn the setting into census space opera.

scanner_en_US: Route names make travel feel owned before it feels adventurous.
field_note_en_US: Every route name should sound like a tariff, not a wonder.

scanner_en_US: The same route means different time for packets, freight and people.
field_note_en_US: Use bands and custody terms until exact systems tuning exists.

scanner_en_US: The shell chain needs small offices for mission text and terminal stamps.
field_note_en_US: Use dull names. Dull names are where liability hides.

scanner_en_US: Names are evidence, not collectible flavor.
field_note_en_US: Seed names must preserve identity without making family melodrama.

scanner_en_US: Job titles should explain what kept the colony alive.
field_note_en_US: Every title should imply a tool, route or failure.

scanner_en_US: A locker should say what a worker touched before the flood.
field_note_en_US: Avoid sentimental clutter. Use work marks.

scanner_en_US: Worker names need localization policy before they become UI bugs.
field_note_en_US: No live name translation. Preserve identity through baked strings.

scanner_en_US: Microstories should change route evidence, not canon truth.
field_note_en_US: Seed variety is for order, names and objects, not contradiction.

scanner_en_US: Recipes should be depth arguments, not shopping lists.
field_note_en_US: Tie recipe tiers to pressure rating and route cost.

scanner_en_US: A good sample can become a hazard by crossing the wrong pressure line.
field_note_en_US: Failure thresholds should be readable before they punish.

scanner_en_US: Blue debt quality is value, risk and evidence in one number.
field_note_en_US: Quality should affect payout, containment and ending pressure.

scanner_en_US: Vent forging should feel like using the planet against itself.
field_note_en_US: Make forge steps readable as heat, pressure, wait and risk.

scanner_en_US: Escape parts should force depth and evidence, not grind.
field_note_en_US: Every ascent component must have a physical and legal reason.

scanner_en_US: Dossier UI should choose risk, not inherited power.
field_note_en_US: No permanent gear advantage in dossier selection.

scanner_en_US: Risk should be continuous pressure, not a binary difficulty switch.
field_note_en_US: Use weights that alter contract conditions, not canon truth.

scanner_en_US: An ending record is evidence, not a trophy shelf.
field_note_en_US: Show who received the payload and what it cost.

scanner_en_US: Save persistence should remember knowledge categories, not hot inventory.
field_note_en_US: Knowledge flags must not change truth ownership or DTO layout.

scanner_en_US: Public articles need spoiler pressure like in-game evidence does.
field_note_en_US: Split what sells the world from what solves the crime.

scanner_en_US: Moon labels can change; orbital roles cannot.
field_note_en_US: Keep Skarn/Vela/Claw/Lumen/Thorne/Anvil/Kestrel/HECTON/Mute roles stable even if public names are replaced.

scanner_en_US: HECTON-8 extraction is limited by eclipse, radiation, relay shutter and ice-scatter windows.
field_note_en_US: This is not a convenient rescue delay; it is the physical timetable that makes escape engineering matter.

scanner_en_US: Aegir moons are not decoration; each public moon label carries a route or salvage role.
field_note_en_US: Use other moons to make HECTON-8 feel embedded in a working system, not isolated fantasy geography.

scanner_en_US: Exact ephemeris numbers are table work; current lore locks route bands and hazard causes.
field_note_en_US: Do not invent exact periods in prose. Use bands until the celestial table owns the numbers.

scanner_en_US: Moon articles can explain hazards and route roles, not final Atlas payload consequences.
field_note_en_US: Aegir articles should make the setting feel large without solving the last act for the player.

scanner_en_US: True-cause knowledge was tiered across risk, Atlas weighting, evacuation law, insurance and recovery offices.
field_note_en_US: This keeps Deep Reach guilty without making every worker omniscient or every executive a cartoon villain.

scanner_en_US: Liability memos must be fragments that match physical rooms, not lore speeches.
field_note_en_US: A useful memo names one margin, one delay, one office and one visible consequence.

scanner_en_US: Signoff records should contradict worker witness hashes and damaged evacuation hardware.
field_note_en_US: The contradiction is stronger than a villain confession because the player sees the room and the stamp disagree.

scanner_en_US: Lower Deep Reach personnel names should be seeded signatures tied to office function.
field_note_en_US: Use names only when they make a memo, stamp, badge or order more playable.

scanner_en_US: The public lie says storm, geotechnical collapse, failed evacuation, corrupted Atlas logs and quarantine loss.
field_note_en_US: The strongest lie is mostly true. It removes weighting, margin and delay.

scanner_en_US: Selling coordinates and XO proof is a real ending, not a joke fail state.
field_note_en_US: The player gets paid and helps the system that buried HECTON-8 return with cleaner paperwork.

scanner_en_US: Atlas is a broken guardian, not a clean villain and not a clean god.
field_note_en_US: Preservation protects the ocean-machine ecology and leaves human justice incomplete.

scanner_en_US: Publishing truth prevents erasure but removes player control over consequences.
field_note_en_US: Public truth is not pure justice. It creates auctions, sanctions, cults, claims and cleanup politics.

scanner_en_US: Severing Atlas is not a simple shutdown button.
field_note_en_US: The act can be mercy for workers, murder for ocean-machine life, liberation from Deep Reach or theft of a living infrastructure.

scanner_en_US: The best ending should not erase cost, uncertainty or complicity.
field_note_en_US: A strong ending lets the player save something real and lose something real.

scanner_en_US: Exact resource yields, stack limits and rarity curves are table-owned.
field_note_en_US: Lore defines categories, pressure behavior and evidence meaning. Balance owns numbers.

scanner_en_US: Escape recipes need bands before numbers: relay, seal, guidance, ascent energy, legal handshake and payload authority.
field_note_en_US: Every escape recipe should ask what physical failure it solves and what deeper route it forces.

scanner_en_US: Risk/reward tuning should be continuous contract pressure, not binary difficulty.
field_note_en_US: A harder contract can pay more, demand better custody, cut windows shorter or hide evidence deeper.

scanner_en_US: Inventory stacks must express physical containment and cargo debt, not arbitrary UI convenience.
field_note_en_US: Blue debt, seals, samples and payload parts should carry pressure and custody logic into inventory.

scanner_en_US: Localization is baked content, not live translation.
field_note_en_US: Draft multilingual rows can exist now; release text needs native review, RTL/font proof and string-pool bake.

scanner_en_US: The contract trap is assembled from clause fragments, not one villain order.
field_note_en_US: Use lower signatures as stamps of procedure: lien merge, oxygen addendum, blacklist risk and payload hold.

scanner_en_US: A packet seal can protect truth or bury it under custody delay.
field_note_en_US: The notary surface is useful because it names relay time, hash witness and custody owner in one place.

scanner_en_US: The gate does not need malice. It needs one unresolved hazard field.
field_note_en_US: Quarantine signatures should be physically paired with broken evacuation hardware or locked survivor routes.

scanner_en_US: A silence vote is not a gun. It can still make people disappear.
field_note_en_US: Pair these signatures with erased names, muted packets and unexplained accounting categories.

scanner_en_US: The old crime has a live queue.
field_note_en_US: Use Return Action signatures whenever Deep Reach pressure arrives through delayed packets, carrier clauses or payload bargains.

scanner_en_US: The colony roster is large enough to feel inhabited and small enough to stay authored.
field_note_en_US: Lock 72 worker identities: 24 anchor names for recurring evidence, 48 seed-role names for replay variation.

scanner_en_US: Crews are verbs: pump, seal, relay, map, forge, triage, cultivate, witness.
field_note_en_US: Use eight crew families: Pump, Seal, Relay, Brine Map, Vent Forge, Triage, Pressure Botany and Payload Witness.

scanner_en_US: Anchor names should reappear through work, not personal exposition.
field_note_en_US: Set A anchors: Mara Venn, Juno Kade, Ren Okoye, Sahana Iqbal, Lian Torres, Oskar Neumann, Aya Morita, Pavel Sorn.

scanner_en_US: Deep names should arrive with damage the player already understands.
field_note_en_US: Set B anchors: Nadiya Rook, Tomas Eline, Keiko Madsen, Harun Vale, Estel Nwosu, Dima Korr, Sofia Leung, Bram Kessel.

scanner_en_US: A seed can move a worker's evidence order, not turn them into disposable text.
field_note_en_US: Seed-role identities combine stable personal name, crew family, route permission, last task and object variant.

scanner_en_US: A locker should show work, route access and what got erased.
field_note_en_US: Variants: tool wear, route permission tag, pressure tape, shift sticker, payroll erasure scar, Marauder preservation mark.

scanner_en_US: Medical evidence should expose delay and routing, not decorate the room with suffering.
field_note_en_US: Variants: crush-status shorthand, oxygen debt mark, route hold crossout, Atlas stabilization note, witness hash gap.

scanner_en_US: A route stamp is stronger than a diary line.
field_note_en_US: Stamps: PUMP, SEAL, RELAY, BRINE, FORGE, TRIAGE, BOTANY, WITNESS. Pair with hatch state and job object.

scanner_en_US: A correction mark can rescue a name or contaminate a claim.
field_note_en_US: Marks: preserve name, challenge category, warn route, price sample, hide witness, mark debt. Keep handwriting functional.

scanner_en_US: Voice is expensive. It must prove something the room also proves.
field_note_en_US: Audio fragments need source prop, transcript damage, route timestamp and one physical contradiction.

scanner_en_US: Public copy can name pressure, route cost and old lies; it must gate Atlas-basin payload truth.
field_note_en_US: Article tiers: public setting, early systems, mid-depth evidence, spoiler-gated endings, internal-only implementation.

scanner_en_US: The PDA should explain only what the player has physically earned.
field_note_en_US: Unlock tiers: scan hint, field note, terminal proof, route-card synthesis, ending record.

scanner_en_US: Damaged audio can hide truth, but subtitles must still serve the player.
field_note_en_US: Use diegetic censor marks for missing route facts; never hide critical accessibility text behind style.

scanner_en_US: An image is release-ready only if it shows an evidence object, route, tool or pressure state.
field_note_en_US: Every art brief needs spoiler tier, primary evidence object, low/mid/high/ultra presentation note and crop-safe text boundary.

scanner_en_US: Draft rows are source coverage. Native review is the release gate.
field_note_en_US: Track locale, owner, script direction, font atlas proof, subtitle proof and page publication status.

scanner_en_US: Thin living mats brighten and oxygenate the first shelf. Hardened edges mark abnormal pressure chemistry.
field_note_en_US: Read the color first, then the edge. Bright growth means oxygen exchange; salt-hard rims mean the chemistry is already under stress.

scanner_en_US: Small transparent grazers scrape mineral film from pressure glass and leave readable route scars.
field_note_en_US: Grazer school: harmless alone, useful as a moving swatch for pressure-glass growth, predator attention and recent water disturbance.

scanner_en_US: A bright plankton drift outlines current, masks small hazards and can pull predators toward tool noise.
field_note_en_US: Lantern drift is not decoration. It is a visibility event with acoustic consequences.

scanner_en_US: Shell clamps bind to rock, cable and capsule plating; the shallow reef already accepts machinery as habitat.
field_note_en_US: Clamp reef: route marker, harvestable shell, early proof that metal is not alien to the ecology anymore.

scanner_en_US: A missing grazer band, a cut in bloom noise and a broad shadow are the first predator warning.
field_note_en_US: Do not reveal the shallow predator as a face first. Reveal absence, sound gap, silhouette, then consequence.

scanner_en_US: Flat brine vanes grow along density boundaries and show where water becomes a wall.
field_note_en_US: Vane forests are not plants in the Earth sense. They are salt-mineral membranes feeding on chemical gradients.

scanner_en_US: Skaters ride the brine interface like a hard surface, leaving ripples where sonar expects open water.
field_note_en_US: Density skaters prove the canyon is a layered machine. Their pathing follows chemistry, not empty space.

scanner_en_US: Colony ribs lock to thermal vents, trapping sulfides and feeding the material routes needed for deep-rated repairs.
field_note_en_US: Vent anchor: resource sign, temperature hazard, biology shelter and first clue that forge chemistry is alive around the edges.

scanner_en_US: A wide filter body clears plankton, bends sonar and can hide or reveal industrial ruins by passing over them.
field_note_en_US: Treat the large filter organism as moving weather. It changes visibility, sound and risk without becoming a scripted monster set-piece.

scanner_en_US: A suspiciously clean silt plate, absent microfauna and low pulse return mark an ambusher before contact.
field_note_en_US: Deep danger must telegraph. The player should learn the wrongness before paying for it.

scanner_en_US: Wet biofilm on cable jackets carries weak charge, slows corrosion and confuses old Deep Reach diagnostics.
field_note_en_US: This is not infection magic. It is a living conductive skin that Atlas can abuse as a repair surface.

scanner_en_US: Gill-like organs around relay pipes damp noise, pass narrow pulses and make sonar lie in repeatable ways.
field_note_en_US: Atlas does not need language here. It needs filters, pulses and living baffles.

scanner_en_US: A crack is sealed by shell growth and biofiber, but the hatch label, handhold and escape mark are buried under it.
field_note_en_US: Atlas repaired the pressure boundary and erased the human route at the same time.

scanner_en_US: Biometal tags sit in growth rings, scars and shell sockets; some animals now carry Deep Reach monitoring hardware as body history.
field_note_en_US: Do not treat the tag as possession. Treat it as a maintenance scar the ecosystem survived around.

scanner_en_US: Small warm nodes cluster at vent margins, drawing power and pushing low-grade repair signals into nearby tissue and metal.
field_note_en_US: Micronodes explain Atlas persistence without granting clean control: local power, local signal, local maintenance.

scanner_en_US: The carrier has racks for samples, drones and legal packets before it has comfort for a human passenger.
field_note_en_US: Black Keel is a working claim tender: rented, impounded, automated and optimized for salvage custody.

scanner_en_US: Ascent sleeve warped, guidance gimbal scarred, relay mast sheared, compressor fouled, heat tile cracked.
field_note_en_US: The capsule can keep the player alive for the first hour. It cannot leave without deep-rated replacement parts.

scanner_en_US: P-63 accepts gasket, clamp, pinger and cutter-contact recipes, but rejects ascent-qualified components without deeper proof.
field_note_en_US: Fabricator authority is a story gate and engineering gate: low-grade survival first, pressure-rated escape later.

scanner_en_US: Suit tags classify service depth, seal fatigue, scrubber capacity, thermal tolerance and contamination handling.
field_note_en_US: A deeper suit is paperwork, pressure proof and ugly maintenance before it is a stat upgrade.

scanner_en_US: A pinger float marks return geometry, exposes false echoes and can draw both rescue attention and unwanted life.
field_note_en_US: The pinger is the first honest tool: it tells distance, debt, route loss and creature risk through sound.

scanner_en_US: The contract has a debt class before it has a destination.
field_note_en_US: Lien severity is the seed's pressure valve: it changes terms, not the player's inherited strength.

scanner_en_US: The storm card marks what the carrier can hear and what it will pretend not to hear.
field_note_en_US: Storm risk is a contract term because orbital geometry and Aegir weather are expensive to wait out.

scanner_en_US: The label decides whether the sample is cargo, evidence or debt.
field_note_en_US: Blue debt is valuable because it is unstable, certified and owned before it is touched.

scanner_en_US: The card does not change the crime. It changes the first proof you can afford to believe.
field_note_en_US: Evidence-order depth keeps repeated campaigns investigative without rewriting the core event.

scanner_en_US: The clause is not a message. It is a hand on the airlock.
field_note_en_US: Recovery Compliance can be quiet for hours and still shape every route through contract language.

scanner_en_US: The approach buffer is short, legal and colder than a rescue call.
field_note_en_US: Black Keel's first voice should be clipped audio plus clean terminal text: enough humanity to sting, not enough to comfort.

scanner_en_US: The screen still knows the words for systems it can no longer move.
field_note_en_US: The first diagnostic should list failures as repair futures: ascent sleeve, guidance, relay, compressor, heat tile.

scanner_en_US: The pump does not care about the plot. It cares about pressure.
field_note_en_US: First repair should teach the grammar of the whole game: physical system, pressure, tool, evidence.

scanner_en_US: The packet is too clean for a drowned room.
field_note_en_US: The first lie must not be stupid. It should be plausible until a physical object makes it indecent.

scanner_en_US: The seal holds. That is the problem.
field_note_en_US: The first Atlas trace should save something small while violating the category of what was saved.

scanner_en_US: A public primer is allowed to be beautiful. It is not allowed to lie.
field_note_en_US: This is the site-facing entry point: ocean moon, dead colony, salvage return, no final payload spoilers.

scanner_en_US: Aegir is not backdrop. It is a timetable with gravity.
field_note_en_US: Public Aegir text should explain why HECTON-8 is far, valuable and inconvenient.

scanner_en_US: The public company name is cleaner than its route history.
field_note_en_US: Site copy should show Deep Reach as plausible infrastructure power before revealing the full liability chain.

scanner_en_US: This page should not open before the player has chosen what Atlas is allowed to mean.
field_note_en_US: Atlas public text must stay gated until the game has earned the broken guardian question.

scanner_en_US: The public name sounds like slang because the official name is built to hide liability.
field_note_en_US: Blue debt text should keep the resource grounded in pressure chemistry, computation and custody.

scanner_en_US: A name lock is not flavor. It is save identity protection.
field_note_en_US: Do not translate HECTON-8, Aegir, Atlas-6, Deep Reach, Black Keel, blue debt or packet IDs into new proper nouns.

scanner_en_US: A unit label can kill clarity if it becomes prose.
field_note_en_US: Keep depth in meters, route time in days/years where authored, debt as tonne-window equivalent, and pressure grades as service labels.

scanner_en_US: A terminal can be cruel by being precise.
field_note_en_US: Use short lines, procedural nouns, passive liability language and hard constraints. Avoid jokes unless Marauder-authored.

scanner_en_US: Silence is part of the audio system.
field_note_en_US: Families: Black Keel clipped/legal, Deep Reach sanitized/compliance, Marauder practical, Atlas wrong-category maintenance.

scanner_en_US: A text box is also a pressure vessel.
field_note_en_US: RTL and CJK passes must prove font coverage, line length, numeric labels, spoiler gates and terminal monospace equivalents.

scanner_en_US: The sample value is not lore. It is a table row with pressure context.
field_note_en_US: Write yield rows by resource class, depth band, containment stage, seed variance and custody grade. Do not bury numbers in articles.

scanner_en_US: This rack stores pressure, not icons.
field_note_en_US: Stack rows need item class, vessel class, pressure certification, contamination stage, mass equivalent and UI warning tier.

scanner_en_US: The recipe is a launch certificate in pieces.
field_note_en_US: Escape rows need component family, certification band, source depth, pressure test, authority proof and failure consequence.

scanner_en_US: The contract is another pressure system.
field_note_en_US: Do not make reward a loot sparkle. Tie payout to return route, custody, evidence order and lien mass.

scanner_en_US: The payout ledger is not the ending. It is the receipt.
field_note_en_US: Every ending row needs receiver, payload route, evidence state, lien adjustment, consequence tag and dossier flag.

scanner_en_US: Known context is not immunity.
field_note_en_US: Suggested UI line: Former Deep Reach field-systems. Current claim status: debt-bound Marauder. Prior records advise; they do not equip.

scanner_en_US: Hide a clause and the UI becomes the lie.
field_note_en_US: Labels: Lien Mass, Storm Window, Custody Grade, Evidence Depth, Clause Weight, Payout Ceiling, Return Penalty.

scanner_en_US: A rumor is a warning, not a map.
field_note_en_US: Suggested labels: Cold Claim, Bad Relay, Clean Money, Missing Shift, Dirty Window, Atlas Residue.

scanner_en_US: A warning that does not change behavior is decoration.
field_note_en_US: Suggested warning pattern: [failure] + [route cost]. Example: Relay shutter: return call may miss carrier window.

scanner_en_US: The record should hurt in one line.
field_note_en_US: Suggested labels: Payload Route, Receiver, Evidence State, Payout, Consequence, Unresolved Cost.

scanner_en_US: Paid. Not cleared.
field_note_en_US: Record fields: receiver Keelmark/Recovery Compliance, evidence withheld, names unresolved, lien reduced, Deep Reach strengthened.

scanner_en_US: Extraction granted. Claim unresolved.
field_note_en_US: Record fields: recovered body or capsule, lien extension, quarantine term, unresolved payload and reentry authority.

scanner_en_US: Witness hash escaped claimant custody.
field_note_en_US: Record fields: Tau/Luyten packet route, witness hash, public proof tier, Deep Reach response delay and uncontrolled consequence.

scanner_en_US: Continuity cut. Damage not contained.
field_note_en_US: Record fields: severed layer, surviving ecology, dead repair nodes, receiver, custody risk and mercy/theft interpretation.

scanner_en_US: Payload withheld. Consequence deferred.
field_note_en_US: Record fields: payload withheld, Deep Reach blind, ecology preserved, Atlas damage active, public truth partial and future pressure unresolved.

scanner_en_US: Cyrillic is not the problem. Tone drift is.
field_note_en_US: Review gate: terse terminal language, stable proper nouns, no softened corporate guilt, no ornamental horror prose.

scanner_en_US: A missing glyph can erase an alarm.
field_note_en_US: Review gate: glyph subset, overflow proof, mixed Latin names, meters/tonne-window labels and spoiler-tier article lengths.

scanner_en_US: Direction is a system, not a decoration.
field_note_en_US: Review gate: bidi numerics, HECTON-8/Aegir/Atlas names, pressure units, carrier clauses and subtitle source tags.

scanner_en_US: A longer word is allowed. A hidden field is not.
field_note_en_US: Review gate: contract label fit, tooltip fallback, unit abbreviations, legal terms and public-site paragraph expansion.

scanner_en_US: A caption can spoil more than a voice.
field_note_en_US: Review gate: speaker/source tag, max line length, alarm priority, sensor justification, censor tier and audio timing.

scanner_en_US: Public copy: beauty first, pressure second, Atlas unnamed.
field_note_en_US: Use this as site hero/body copy seed: ocean moon, dead colony, salvage contract, pressure geography, no final-truth spoilers.

scanner_en_US: Aegir map copy must read as timing pressure, not astronomy wallpaper.
field_note_en_US: Use short map labels: relay shutter, radiation surge, ice-grain scatter, guidance lag, claim orbit.

scanner_en_US: Deep Reach copy: not cartoon villains; culpable weighting under real physics.
field_note_en_US: Use the public lie as contrast: real tide, real failure, missing weighting layer, missing delayed rescue chain.

scanner_en_US: Atlas public text stops at failed governor unless spoiler gate opens.
field_note_en_US: Gate label should name categories: factory-temple, repair ecology, ending payloads, worker evidence.

scanner_en_US: Blue debt public copy must mention containment and custody, not miracle ore.
field_note_en_US: Use resource copy for site cards, sample images, merch-safe public wiki and non-spoiler economy context.

scanner_en_US: Blackbox fragment confirms ascent sleeve spent during survival burn.
field_note_en_US: Short audio: crush-frame, avionics flood, recovery ring shear, buoy unreliable, no narrator explanation.

scanner_en_US: Work order lists pump, seal, cut, pinger and fabricator in pressure order.
field_note_en_US: Place on pump room terminal or soaked clipboard; no tutorial language.

scanner_en_US: Nameplate has route tag, clamp certification and erased payroll stripe.
field_note_en_US: Example prop copy: REN OKOYE / Clamp route B / cutter cert active / payroll stripe sanded.

scanner_en_US: Correction note crosses out accident and writes weighted delay.
field_note_en_US: Example prop copy: NOT WEATHER. AUTH DELAY. CHECK PUMP CERT, SHIFT COUNT, BODY CATEGORY.

scanner_en_US: Relay fragment approves extraction and denies clean release in the same packet.
field_note_en_US: Use after partial exit/corporate rescue routes; keep it legal, cold and bitter.

scanner_en_US: Photic mat: oxygen-positive, pressure-fragile, edible to grazers, dangerous when torn.
field_note_en_US: Cut samples only from loose edges. If the mat is sealing a crack, it is already doing a job you may need later.

scanner_en_US: Glass grazer: non-hostile. If the school freezes, leave the open water.
field_note_en_US: When the school locks still, stop treating the clearing as safe. Something is reading the same water you are.

scanner_en_US: Lantern drift: useful light. Verify current, charge and residue before following.
field_note_en_US: Follow the glow only after current and residue agree. Pretty light is not a route plan.

scanner_en_US: Brine vane: density-shear root. Follow aligned edges; avoid open glow and false-floor returns.
field_note_en_US: Vertical beauty, bad floor. Keep one vane edge in sight and one hand on buoyancy trim.

scanner_en_US: Sensor-tagged fauna: living carrier, old tag, partial Atlas route echo.
field_note_en_US: The tag is a scar, not a leash. Expect dirty telemetry and a nervous animal.

scanner_en_US: Machine field warning: silt motion does not match current.
field_note_en_US: Late-game warning should be quiet and objective, not boss buildup.

scanner_en_US: Basin gate requires pressure proof and authority response.
field_note_en_US: Final threshold should read like a service gate to a living factory, not a fantasy portal.

scanner_en_US: Entry fragment: alloy, shell sealant, human tool, active repair pulse.
field_note_en_US: Visual rule: temple only because industry and tissue have become ritual through repetition.

scanner_en_US: Payload check: receiver changes meaning, not only reward.
field_note_en_US: Use immediately before irreversible ending route selection.

scanner_en_US: Dossier note: closure denied; consequence retained.
field_note_en_US: Use as post-ending summary seed and replay bridge; never call it perfect victory.

scanner_en_US: Yield row contract: resource class, pressure band, custody grade, depletion rule.
field_note_en_US: Use for the gameplay table pass; do not invent final yields in public or in terminal logs.

scanner_en_US: Stack row contract: vessel class and contamination stage beat icon count.
field_note_en_US: Stack limits must stay table-owned and stable for save identity.

scanner_en_US: Escape recipe row: component class, pressure tier, route proof, authority state.
field_note_en_US: Use bands from RS035; exact costs belong to recipe tables.

scanner_en_US: Contract row: lien, storm window, custody, evidence order, clause weight.
field_note_en_US: Do not tune reward by writing new lore. Tune the row.

scanner_en_US: Ending row: receiver, custody, evidence state, payout, consequence.
field_note_en_US: Use this before tuning credits, quarantine delay or dossier flags.

scanner_en_US: PDA proof: hint, fragment, proof, synthesis, ending record.
field_note_en_US: Runtime implementation still needs Unity device proof and baked string-pool binding.

scanner_en_US: Scanner proof: 25, 50, 100 percent packet stages must map to physical evidence.
field_note_en_US: Use for ScannableFragment stage binding pass.

scanner_en_US: Terminal proof: limited slots, packet hash, operator surface, no live markdown.
field_note_en_US: TerminalOS expansion remains a Unity placement task, not this source pass.

scanner_en_US: Dossier proof: ending family, receiver, evidence state, route warning, unresolved cost.
field_note_en_US: Use for ending record UI implementation and save-profile knowledge flags.

scanner_en_US: Localization proof: long labels, CJK, RTL and subtitle timing need layout evidence.
